title: Node workspace-checkpoint tests time out under heavy host load
description:
While make gate ran concurrently on this host, two existing node-suite tests in harness/test/node/workspace-checkpoints.test.ts failed once (one took 33.5 s, past its timeout) and passed on the next run. They drive real git and real processes through the local door, and their time grows with host load; per the repo's flaky-means-bug rule it wants a deterministic bound or a longer per-test timeout.
evidence: pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts test/node/workspace-checkpoints.test.ts during make gate: 'destroys the container BETWEEN tool rounds' 33500ms, failed
